macros.name: makecoststable
macros.doc: This command creates a summary of costs table, for each participant, if the sum of the costs for “travel”, “equipment”, and “goods and services” exceeds 15% of the personnel costs for that participant.

macros.name: makedeliverablelist
macros.doc: This command creates the List of Deliverables Table 3.1c required by the EU template.

macros.name: makelritable
macros.doc: This command creates a table for every participant that declares costs of large research infrastructure irrespective of the percentage of personnel costs (see Article 6.2 of the General Model Agreement).

macros.name: makerisklist
macros.doc: This command creates the Critical risks for implementation Table 3.2b required by the EU template.

macros.name: maketasklist
macros.doc: The command creates an ordered list of tasks with Task ID, PI name (in case it is defined in the \wptask macro), start and end dates, and task title.

macros.name: makewplist
macros.doc: This command creates the work package (wp) list required as Table 3.1b in the EU proposal template.

macros.name: personmonths
macros.doc: This macro specifies the person months used for each participant.

macros.name: shortname
macros.doc: This macro require as argument the proposal short name.

macros.name: wpend
macros.doc: This macro specifies the wp end month.

macros.name: wpstart
macros.doc: This macro specifies the wp start month.

macros.name: wptask
macros.doc: The \wptask macro creates an ordered list of tasks within the wpdescription environment and stores the data relative to the WP tasks.

macros.name: wptype
macros.doc: This macro specifies the wp activity type, and should be one of: “RTD”, “DEM”, “MGT”, or “OTHER”.
